headline: Platform Engineer: Kubernetes, Terraform and Python for product teams that ship every day
summary: Platform engineer with about 3.5 years of professional engineering, about 2 years in a platform title. At Example Corp, since January 2023, I run the deployment platform of the payments team and moved 40 services to Kubernetes. At Sample Labs, from March 2021 to December 2022, I built internal tools in Python and React for the support team. Bachelor of Computer Science, Example Institute of Technology, 2021.
highlights: Moved 40 services to Kubernetes at Example Corp
Owner of the deployment platform of the payments team
Internal tools in Python and React at Sample Labs

bullets: Run the deployment platform of the payments team, from the first commit to production, with Kubernetes, Terraform and AWS.
Moved 40 services to Kubernetes, one service at a time, with Terraform modules on AWS shared by every team.
Wrote the platform's backend services in Python with FastAPI and PostgreSQL, and its dashboards in React.
Keep the platform's runbooks and the on-call notes of the payments team.
Built internal tools in Python and React for the support team.
Worked with TypeScript on the frontend of those tools.
Wrote the tests of the support tools with pytest.
